itinerary.title: Srinagar temples at a measured pace
itinerary.place: Shankaracharya · Sharika Devi or Jyeshtha Devi
itinerary.description: Choose a principal Srinagar temple visit, such as Shankaracharya, with its hill approach and steps assessed in advance. Sharika Devi in the Hari Parbat area or Jyeshtha Devi can be requested as an additional or alternative visit, not a promise to climb to every site. Darshan, photography, belongings and vehicle access follow current custodian and security rules.

Sharika Devi or Jyeshtha Devi: choose around interests and effort
experiences: Time for a temple visit without rushing

itinerary.title: The spring sanctuary at Tulmulla
itinerary.description: Reserve a separate outing for Kheer Bhawani at Tulmulla in Ganderbal. Allow time at the temple and spring surroundings and follow the resident community’s current guidance about offerings and conduct. Festival attendance is not assumed, and no festival date, priority entry or special ritual is included without a specific confirmed arrangement.

itinerary.title: Mattan’s sacred spring and Martand’s architecture
itinerary.description: Set aside a full road day for Mattan and the Martand Sun Temple remains near Anantnag. Treat the living sacred-spring visit at Mattan and the archaeological remains at Martand as distinct places. The guide confirms current site rules and a workable return time. Ceremonies, priest services and offerings are not included or guaranteed by this sightseeing proposal.
places: Martand Sun Temple remains: a separate heritage visit
experiences: Local context for the sacred spring and temple architecture
A meal break and adequate return buffer

Additional shrines or outlying sites need a revised itinerary rather than a last-minute detour.
